name: Cable Seated Row
steps: Sit upright at a low cable row station with knees slightly bent and feet braced on the footplates.
Reach forward to grip the handle with both hands, keeping your spine tall and shoulders set.
Pull the handle toward your lower ribs by driving your elbows straight back beside your torso.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together briefly, then extend your arms forward under control.
tips: Keep your back tall as your shoulder blades glide forward and back.
Avoid swinging your torso backward to pull the handle or shrugging your shoulders.
